fix_pass_4.result: Billing payment visibility is reused for contact-only module rows; Include, published Include, scoped ReadView and HTTP published view hide the row outside the contact wall, retain allowed-user access and restore it after wall removal.

A module-appended payment.future_event on fee_agreement appears in Activities and REST/MCP events and is delivered with a verified signature. Walled payment.created and a differently named payment-record event remain hidden.
